import sys

class CBubbleStrike:
    def get_prob(self, x, n):
        return (3.0 / 2.0) * x / n * (n - x) / (n - 1) * (n - x - 1) / (n - 2) + \
               3.0 * x / n * (x - 1) / (n - 1) * (n - x) / (n - 2) + \
               1.0 * x / n * (x - 1) / (n - 1) * (x - 2) / (n - 2)

    def solve(self):
        n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
        p = float(sys.stdin.readline())
        x = 0
        while self.get_prob(x, n) < p:
            x += 1
        print(x)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solver = CBubbleStrike()
    solver.solve()
